title: 1964 Walkout, protesting for only one time. (Standard or Daylight but not both)
description: In 1964, a mix-up during the period when some communities switched to Daylight Saving Time while others remained on Standard Time led Hartland High School students to stage a walkout. The accompanying photo shows several protesting students holding signs that read, "We Want One Time."
